Picked 2026-08-31: C · Ledger — white ground, recessed indigo panels, borders over elevation. Chosen over A · Indigo wash (tinted ground) and B · Porcelain (white panels on grey ground).

Values are the light token set in design/tokens.css (ADR-0017): system preference by default, header pin wins; washes promoted to tokens — sel .12 · rule 1 · precov .35 (dark: .06 · .7 · .22). Floor: worst text 5.18:1, stage hues ≥6.5:1 on panel.
